status: implemented, not yet run on a rehearsal runtime
why: S9.6i rank 1: the CityGML conversion was queued only when the native read settled; queuing it at probe
saves up to 20.7 s (small) and 35.6 s (medium) of run 5's time to the first layer.

lines: intake-native-readers.ts:289 (base): every CityGML summary converts; the converter checks each geometry's own
system declaration (comment at 279-283), so no reading value decides it.
intake-native-derivative.ts:337-364: queueNativeDerivativeTx takes the source row and card only; its payload
pins (caseRevision, sourceRevision, sourceSha256, sourcePin, subject, accessSha256) come from the source and
the case scope, which the probe transaction holds.
intake-native-derivative.ts:527-554: convertNativeLayers reads the item, source and card format; from plan_ref
only officer layer answers and the cited nativeReaderJobId (withReading, a citation the probe already wrote).
intake-draft.ts:709-725: the claim re-checks source and item pins and caseRevision >= its pin; the native
read's item writes change none of them.
whatTheConversionNeeds.cityjsonExcluded: intake-native-readers.ts:290: CityJSON converts only when its reading's referenceSystemState is declared, a value only the native read produces, so it still waits for its reading.

change: intake-native-readers.ts: the CityGML reader is marked convertsAtProbe; queueIntakeNativeReaderTx queues the
conversion (queueNativeDerivativeTx, unchanged) in the same transaction, after the reading, with the pins it
gave after a reading. settleIntakeNativeReaderTx, for a CityGML item with any conversion job (queued, running
or ended), queues none and writes no words: the conversion's end writes the item's words, as it did after a
converted reading. A stale reading is re-pinned keeping the item's words and layers, so its replay converts
nothing and the item is never left reading with empty words. Items probed before this change (no conversion
job) take the old path unchanged.
Lanes: citygml-native stays model3d and intake-native-derivative vector (dispatch-lanes.ts unchanged); each
runs only within its own lane's limit; no limit or budget changed.

newSql.statement: SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE source_id=$1 AND operation='intake-native-derivative' LIMIT 1

added: a probed CityGML queues its reading and its conversion together, with the pins a reading end gives
a reading converting its outlines queues no second conversion, conversion queued/running/succeeded/failed/stale
a reading ending without outlines leaves the words its conversion wrote first
a stale reading re-pinned after its conversion ended keeps the words and converts once
any CityGML stop beside its conversion keeps it, words unchanged (failCityGMLJob path)
changedExpectations: CityGML job counts at probe include the conversion; the re-pin before the first part keeps the conversion's
words. The loops for failed/stale/two re-pins and the six re-pin refusals run CityGML as an item probed
before this change (readingAlone), since they test the reader path every format shares.
tests.postgres: intake-native-readers-postgres.test.ts on postgis/postgis 01a6a70e41e6, 127.0.0.1:25446, database/sql bootstrap then migrate: 3 tests, 3 pass; container removed

gaps: When the conversion ends before the native read, convertNativeLayers marks the item read at once (its end is
outside the queue path). A re-pin while a started conversion runs leaves the item citing the stale reading,
because the conversion's end writes the plan_ref it read when it started.
